intro: The Enchanted Resonite Crystal is an alchemically altered mineral infused with shamanic magic by Mor'rogal in the Stonetalon Mountains. It is crafted specifically to shatter the Resonite cask binding a slumbering, ancient Earthen named Goggeroc.

p: Raw resonite crystals gathered from the deep caverns of the Stonetalon Mountains possess unusual harmonic and earthen properties. Recognizing the danger slumbering within a sealed subterranean cask, the shaman Mor'rogal altered the raw minerals using his elemental powers. The resulting Enchanted Resonite Crystal serves as a precise tool: when struck against the reinforced Resonite cask, it disrupts the housing and forcibly rouses the giant Earthen Goggeroc while he is still disoriented from his long sleep.
